title: GatewayModelRoute
description: An operator-pinned route; stale alias/model revisions or target mismatch refuse calls until both gateway and checker configuration are refreshed.

credentialEnv.description: Name of the environment variable from which the gateway reads this route's provider credential at runtime. A reference only, never a value: Muistamo never stores provider credentials (NFR-08). Only MUISTAMO_PROVIDER_KEY_* names, so a configuration can never send another gateway secret upstream. The pinned gateway refuses to start when the variable is unset.

baseUrl.description: Trusted operator-pinned deployment endpoint, without credentials, query or fragment. The later renderer must emit this exact target and the matching configuration fingerprint together. Not independent provider-region verification.
